title: Emergence of Gram-negative Resistance in Blood Culture Isolates of Solid-organ Transplant Recipients
brief_summary: The information collected will provide insight in to the epidemiology of antibiotic resistance in a transplant compared to a non-transplant population. Data is needed regarding the date of admission, date of bloodstream infection and location of ward/ICU so trends in the emergence of resistance and antibiotic usage can be detected.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients with a positive blood culture isolate growing a gram-negative organism will be included from 1996 - 2005
